name: Superman Hold
cues: Lie face down with your arms reaching forward
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest, arms and legs
Keep your neck long and your eyes on the floor
Hold the top with your knees straight

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: The pose is right: lumbar -13..-16, thorax -8..-10, hip extension 11-14 deg, knees 3 deg, chest/hands/feet off the mat (hands 0.37-0.45 m, balls 0.33-0.38 m), lower back visible from az -115. matUnder sizes the mat to the low capsules only (1.0 m minimum), so arms and legs hang well past both ends of a short pad in the hero.
